links: Maximize visual display surface without structural stress -> ground adaptation after flight became metabolically unsustainable -> 0.88g gravity with 22% oxygen and 1.1 bar pressure limit sustained flight envelope

skill.effect: The creature spreads its flag-like hand-wings and performs a lively, rhythmic dance that strongly lifts the spirits of nearby allies and stuns opponents for a short while.

chains.weakness: Completely immobile during display; vulnerable to ambush predators.
observe: Wing membranes reduced to frayed, ribbon-like hands
Legs permanently splayed from perching ancestry

journal.en: Civilization died the moment they forgot how to throw a stone.

plausibility.summary: Flight loss should follow removal of Qu-engineered high-output cardiac/aerobic shunt, not Earth's gravity/O2 alone on this world.
fixes: Flight loss should follow removal of Qu-engineered high-output cardiac/aerobic shunt, not Earth's gravity/O2 alone on this world.

links: High aerobic metabolism without flight -> 22% O2 and 1.1 bar pressure support elevated baseline heat -> K2V spectrum delivers steady visible light but low UV cooling -> heat dissipation shifts to cranial frills and padded feet

skill.effect: The creature settles down and fans its thermoregulatory frills to vent excess heat, causing its skin to stiffen and making it far more resilient to attacks while it rests.

chains.weakness: Frills collapse if dehydrated; requires frequent water access.
observe: Collapsible dermal flaps along the neck
Padded, splayed feet for ground contact

journal.en: They wear their cooling systems like crowns.

plausibility.summary: Anchor frill vasculature to residual flyer-grade heat load on the ground; de-emphasize K2V UV as the cooling driver.
fixes: Anchor frill vasculature to residual flyer-grade heat load on the ground; de-emphasize K2V UV as the cooling driver.

relations.note: Flyers maintain turbine hearts and digitigrade wing membranes to exploit aerial niches; Hand Flappers shed flight musculature, shrinking wings to flag-hands and shifting to ground-dwelling thermoregulation.
Hand Flappers mimic Mantelope mournful harmonies to infiltrate herds and steal grazing time, exploiting acoustic overlap in dense air.
